data.one_liner: Add nestable, resizable containers with custom dividers to your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Provides resizable container widgets with draggable dividers that support nesting, LTR and RTL layouts, and flexible sizing rules such as pixels, ratios, expand, and shrink. It also includes a controller to programmatically manage sizes and listen to changes.
use_when: You need split-pane or multi-panel layouts with user-adjustable dividers.
You require nestable resizable layouts supporting both horizontal and vertical directions.
avoid_when: You just need standard static layouts without resizing capabilities.
Your child widgets do not have a natural size when using shrink configurations.
strengths: Fully nestable containers supporting LTR and RTL.
Highly customizable dividers with hover, drag, and tap callbacks.
Supports absolute pixels, proportional ratios, expanding flex, and shrink sizing.
weaknesses: Requires proper controller disposal and size boundary configurations to avoid unexpected layout shifts.
Using shrink requires children to have a natural size to avoid rendering errors.
